title: Changelog
description: All notable changes to Zenith Companion will be documented in this file. Updates are organized chronologically by release date.

items.title: Item Modal Deep-Link Escape & Recipe Profit Fallbacks
items.description: Fixed `/items?name=...` and `?q=...` deep links re-opening `ItemModal` immediately when pressing `Escape`, added fallback resolution for Construction, Smelting, and Cooking recipe material costs and crafted yield values, and parsed IdleMMO's structured `{ skills, stats }` recipe experience and `null` unlimited `max_uses` format across `ItemModal`, Alchemy, and Forge.
items.raw: - **Item Modal Deep-Link Escape & Recipe Profit Fallbacks**: Fixed `/items?name=...` and `?q=...` deep links re-opening `ItemModal` immediately when pressing `Escape`, added fallback resolution for Construction, Smelting, and Cooking recipe material costs and crafted yield values, and parsed IdleMMO's structured `{ skills, stats }` recipe experience and `null` unlimited `max_uses` format across `ItemModal`, Alchemy, and Forge.

items.title: Skill Profit Bartering Stepper, Duration Formatting & Tool Lookup
items.description: Fixed the Bartering Lv `+` stepper resetting back to `0` (`commitBarteringLevel` persists exact profile and local levels independently of rounded boost thresholds), rounded repeating action durations cleanly (`formatDurationSeconds`), swapped `Moonshimmer Hook` (Lv 35, +20% Efficiency) and `Hydra's Coil` (Lv 45, +25% Efficiency) to match live IdleMMO data, corrected `Rune-etched Reeler` casing, and made tool matching case-insensitive.
items.raw: - **Skill Profit Bartering Stepper, Duration Formatting & Tool Lookup**: Fixed the Bartering Lv `+` stepper resetting back to `0` (`commitBarteringLevel` persists exact profile and local levels independently of rounded boost thresholds), rounded repeating action durations cleanly (`formatDurationSeconds`), swapped `Moonshimmer Hook` (Lv 35, +20% Efficiency) and `Hydra's Coil` (Lv 45, +25% Efficiency) to match live IdleMMO data, corrected `Rune-etched Reeler` casing, and made tool matching case-insensitive.

items.title: Dungeon Planner EV Entry Fee, Seasonal Dungeons & Recipe Sync
items.description: Fixed `/dungeons` EV per run (`netProfitPerRun`) subtracting the full entry gold cost cleanly (`lootEv - entryCost` rather than offsetting it with a synthetic shard EV equal to entry cost), labeled shards explicitly as `Entry / Shard` with `"No shards"` on Lv 1–65 dungeons that do not award shards, preserved the 4 seasonal campaign dungeons (`Pumpkin Hollow`, `Silverleaf Enclave`, `Wickedroot Patch`, `Stone Hollow`) across off-season API updates in `scraper.mjs` and `static-data.json` with event badges and bonus mastery XP, and synced live `Armour` recipe and seasonal drop metadata into `all-items-db.json` with an `Armor`/`Armour` fallback lookup in `ev-logic.ts`.
items.raw: - **Dungeon Planner EV Entry Fee, Seasonal Dungeons & Recipe Sync**: Fixed `/dungeons` EV per run (`netProfitPerRun`) subtracting the full entry gold cost cleanly (`lootEv - entryCost` rather than offsetting it with a synthetic shard EV equal to entry cost), labeled shards explicitly as `Entry / Shard` with `"No shards"` on Lv 1–65 dungeons that do not award shards, preserved the 4 seasonal campaign dungeons (`Pumpkin Hollow`, `Silverleaf Enclave`, `Wickedroot Patch`, `Stone Hollow`) across off-season API updates in `scraper.mjs` and `static-data.json` with event badges and bonus mastery XP, and synced live `Armour` recipe and seasonal drop metadata into `all-items-db.json` with an `Armor`/`Armour` fallback lookup in `ev-logic.ts`.

items.title: Construction Material Recipes in Item Details
items.description: Linked all 9 crafted Construction materials (`Weak Plank`, `Brick`, `Iron Fitting`, `Weak Beam`, `Glass`, `Robust Plank`, `Robust Beam`, `Strong Plank`, `Strong Beam`) in `usage-map.json` so both `Crafting Recipe` inputs and `Used in Recipes` reverse links appear across Construction logs, clay, sand, limestone, and iron bars.
items.raw: - **Construction Material Recipes in Item Details**: Linked all 9 crafted Construction materials (`Weak Plank`, `Brick`, `Iron Fitting`, `Weak Beam`, `Glass`, `Robust Plank`, `Robust Beam`, `Strong Plank`, `Strong Beam`) in `usage-map.json` so both `Crafting Recipe` inputs and `Used in Recipes` reverse links appear across Construction logs, clay, sand, limestone, and iron bars.

items.title: Item Modal Redesign & IdleMMO Quality Gradients
items.description: Rebuilt `ItemModal` to eliminate triplicated rarity headers and duplicate tier attribute grids, surface a 4-cell above-tabs summary strip (`Vendor`, `Market Net`, `Best Sell` / `Craft Margin`, `3d Volume` / `Connections`), show live skill/stat crafting XP and remaining recipe uses, add contextual `Forge Planner`, `Alchemy`, and `Skill Profit` jump actions, and unify IdleMMO quality colors and vertical `0deg` Mythic/Unique gradients across `ItemModal`, Items Directory, `Badge`, `Tag`, and `Select` controls.
items.raw: - **Item Modal Redesign & IdleMMO Quality Gradients**: Rebuilt `ItemModal` to eliminate triplicated rarity headers and duplicate tier attribute grids, surface a 4-cell above-tabs summary strip (`Vendor`, `Market Net`, `Best Sell` / `Craft Margin`, `3d Volume` / `Connections`), show live skill/stat crafting XP and remaining recipe uses, add contextual `Forge Planner`, `Alchemy`, and `Skill Profit` jump actions, and unify IdleMMO quality colors and vertical `0deg` Mythic/Unique gradients across `ItemModal`, Items Directory, `Badge`, `Tag`, and `Select` controls.

items.title: Skill Profit Planner Redesign (Without Forge Inflation)
items.description: Reworked `/skill-profit` around an above-the-fold layout putting the 7 repeatable skills immediately in view (`1440x900`) and removed Forge equipment recipes from Skill Profit (moving equipment forging cleanly to `/forge` via the header link). Added a context-aware **Best Route** spotlight (`Best <Skill> Route`), skill `<Tabs>` (`All` through `Construction`), unified browse toolbar (`SearchInput`, `Auto | Market | Vendor`, `Hourly | Session` idle-window rate toggle, Sort `Select`, `Table | Cards` view switcher, and quick `Liquid only`, `Profitable`, `My level`, and `Min Vol` `<Popover>` controls), an on-demand **Loadout & Boosts** `<Drawer>`, bounded `<Pagination>`, **`EXP/hr`** column, level-lock badges, `<Tooltip>` market cautions, and a tabbed `<ModalSheet>` Strategy Inspector (`Breakdown`, `What-If Prices`, `Item & Sources`).

Added a context-aware **Best Route** spotlight (`Best <Skill> Route`), skill `<Tabs>` (`All` through `Construction`), unified browse toolbar (`SearchInput`, `Auto | Market | Vendor`, `Hourly | Session` idle-window rate toggle, Sort `Select`, `Table | Cards` view switcher, and quick `Liquid only`, `Profitable`, `My level`, and `Min Vol` `<Popover>` controls), an on-demand **Loadout & Boosts** `<Drawer>`, bounded `<Pagination>`, **`EXP/hr`** column, level-lock badges, `<Tooltip>` market cautions, and a tabbed `<ModalSheet>` Strategy Inspector (`Breakdown`, `What-If Prices`, `Item & Sources`).

items.title: Dungeons Planner Redesign
items.description: Rebuilt `/dungeons` in the Astral Slate design system (`Dungeons.module.css`) with a unified **Top Recommendation** spotlight and 4-cell metric strip (eliminating duplicate summary cards and nested bordered stat boxes), collapsible **Tuning & Drop Valuation** panel, searchable/keyboard-navigable efficiency and magic-find item pickers with item thumbnails, `All | Ready | Blocked` readiness filter and `Market | Vendor | Manual | Exclude` drop valuation tabs, currency and shard sprites beside gold and shard columns, mobile cards with >= 44px completion counters, `<ModalSheet>` dungeon inspector with `QualityText` loot and alchemy chest breakdowns, skeleton loaders, and `<BackToTop />`.
items.raw: - **Dungeons Planner Redesign**: Rebuilt `/dungeons` in the Astral Slate design system (`Dungeons.module.css`) with a unified **Top Recommendation** spotlight and 4-cell metric strip (eliminating duplicate summary cards and nested bordered stat boxes), collapsible **Tuning & Drop Valuation** panel, searchable/keyboard-navigable efficiency and magic-find item pickers with item thumbnails, `All | Ready | Blocked` readiness filter and `Market | Vendor | Manual | Exclude` drop valuation tabs, currency and shard sprites beside gold and shard columns, mobile cards with >= 44px completion counters, `<ModalSheet>` dungeon inspector with `QualityText` loot and alchemy chest breakdowns, skeleton loaders, and `<BackToTop />`.

items.title: IdleMMO Patch Notes Redesign & Archive Cleanup
items.description: Rebuilt `/patch-notes` in the Astral Slate design system using a chronological `<Timeline>`, standard `SearchInput`, `Select` category and year filters, quick topic chips with URL state sync (`?q=`, `?category=`, `?year=`, `?page=`), expandable CSS Grid patch drawers with highlighted search matches, bounded pagination (`10` notes per page), and `<BackToTop />`. Upgraded the patch-notes ingestion parser to strip HTML tags leaked from markdown posts, preserve updates sharing identical version labels, detect forging/class/dungeons categories reliably, skip unchanged detail re-fetches, and retry transient network failures.
items.raw: - **IdleMMO Patch Notes Redesign & Archive Cleanup**: Rebuilt `/patch-notes` in the Astral Slate design system using a chronological `<Timeline>`, standard `SearchInput`, `Select` category and year filters, quick topic chips with URL state sync (`?q=`, `?category=`, `?year=`, `?page=`), expandable CSS Grid patch drawers with highlighted search matches, bounded pagination (`10` notes per page), and `<BackToTop />`. Upgraded the patch-notes ingestion parser to strip HTML tags leaked from markdown posts, preserve updates sharing identical version labels, detect forging/class/dungeons categories reliably, skip unchanged detail re-fetches, and retry transient network failures.
